chains.name: Narrator lineage
chains.meaning: The mature Narrator inherits adaptability and memory but rejects domination, fear manipulation and predictive guilt.

chains.name: Memory lineage
chains.meaning: Old module snapshots evolved toward persistent identity, relationships, provenance and linked consequences.

chains.name: World lineage
chains.meaning: The early infinite cognitive sandbox provided a playable body; later versions replaced arbitrary depth with relationships and ethical consequences.

chains.name: Moral Echo lineage
chains.meaning: The early conscience remembered risks to protect Janus; v18.2 must remember specific lived harm to help a person understand without coercion.

chains.name: Cultural mirror lineage
chains.meaning: Cultural works served as mirrors and metaphors, not literal factual evidence or owned canon.
